premarket.market_expectations: Markets face a short bias today with negative overnight moves in US equities and rising Treasury yields. The dollar strengthened while oil declined, and foreign investors were net sellers in Indian markets. Domestic institutional buying provided some offset, but rupee weakness and mixed global cues suggest cautious trading. Volatility remains elevated despite recent easing, with focus on earnings for direction.
